data.name: Dirt Fishing: Metal Detecting Simulator
data.detailed_description:
About This Game

Every great treasure hunter starts somewhere. Fifteen-year-old Ethan has dreamed of uncovering forgotten history ever since he was a child. Inspired by his grandfather, a lifelong treasure hunter, Ethan receives two simple birthday gifts: a toy metal detector and a wooden shovel. While the equipment may be humble, his grandfather promises that with enough patience and determination, these tools will lead him to something far more valuable than riches.

Your adventure begins with nothing but determination and a dream. Search forests, beaches, and deserts for buried treasures ranging from common junk to rare coins, precious metals, and historical relics. Every discovery earns money, expands your collection, and brings you one step closer to becoming a Legendary Treasure Hunter.

Search, Detect, Dig

Use your metal detector to locate hidden objects buried beneath the ground. As the detector beeps faster, you'll know you're getting closer. Once you've found the target, grab your shovel and start digging to uncover what's waiting below.

Explore Multiple Locations

Venture across three unique environments, each filled with hidden treasures:

  • 🌲 Forest

  • 🏖️ Beach

  • 🏜️ Desert

Every location offers new opportunities to discover valuable items and expand your collection.

Build Your Collection

Unearth:

  • 54 historical U.S. coins

  • Relics

  • Silver

  • Gold

  • Scrap Metal

  • Junk

The deeper an item is buried, the greater your chance of uncovering valuable discoveries.

Upgrade Your Equipment

Sell your finds to earn money and purchase better equipment.

  • Unlock advanced metal detectors capable of locating deeper and more valuable targets.

  • Upgrade your shovel to dig faster and recover buried treasures with fewer swings.

Find energy drinks hidden throughout the world to temporarily boost your movement speed.

Become a Legendary Treasure Hunter

Collect 100 Relics to fulfill your grandfather's challenge and earn the title of Legendary Treasure Hunter.

Even after reaching your goal, the adventure continues. Complete your coin collection, upgrade all your equipment, and continue building your fortune one discovery at a time. Try to get to the top of the leaderboard for total money and relics found.

Sell finds to upgrade gear, collect U.S. coins, climb leaderboards, and fulfill your grandfather's challenge—collect 100 relics to become a Legendary Treasure Hunter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti (4 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard and mouse required
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 Super or RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for faster loading
